intro: A lot of new building in Tumkur, from engineering colleges to housing projects near the industrial area, is designed by architects based in Bengaluru, a short drive down the highway. FunPlay Systems works with these architects, and directly with schools, colleges and parks. We make all our outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai East, about 810 km away.

Tumkur, also written Tumakuru, is a district headquarters in southern Karnataka, known for the Siddaganga Math and its many educational institutions. The weather is milder than in the plains further north, with a monsoon from June to October. Equipment comes from Vasai by road and is fixed on site by our installation team or a dealer in south India. Send us your site plan, and we will return a layout drawing with every safe play area marked.

sections.h: Working with your architect on a play area
sections.html:
Architects usually want three things from us early: the footprint of each piece, the safe play area around it and the type of base it needs. Our layout drawing gives all of these, so the play area can go onto the site plan before levels and drains are fixed. Tell us if the area sits on a podium or over a basement, because that decides between self-standing and grouted installation.

Share the colour scheme of the buildings, and we can suggest shades from our range to go with it. For a larger feature piece, look at the NexLev Series. For Bengaluru projects, see our Bangalore page.

faq.q: Can you send drawings to our architect?
faq.a: Yes. We send a layout drawing that shows each piece, its footprint and the safe play area around it. Your architect can place it on the site plan before work on levels and drainage starts.

faq.q: Can play equipment go on a podium or terrace?
faq.a: Yes, on self-standing bases that need no digging. Tell us early if the play area sits over a basement so we plan the right installation method.

faq.q: Do you supply Tumkur?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai East, about 810 km away, and install through our own team or a dealer in south India.

intro: Udaipur's hotels and lakeside resorts host a steady stream of families and destination weddings, and guests travelling with children soon look for somewhere for them to play. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for hotels, resorts, schools and housing societies in Udaipur at our factory in Vasai East, about 590 km away.

The city lies among the Aravalli hills in southern Rajasthan. It is hot and dry from March to June and pleasant in winter, with a short monsoon in between. Many properties here are built in a heritage style, with stone, arches and courtyards, so a bright plastic structure can look out of place. We bring the equipment by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in western India. Share photos of your garden and the look you want to keep, and we will suggest pieces and a layout with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Play areas that suit a heritage hotel
sections.html:
Wooden structures from our NexLev Woody range sit well beside stone walls and old trees. If you prefer roto-moulded equipment, choose softer, earthy shades from our colour range and keep the brightest colours for small details. Ask about the available shades when you share your photos.

Place the play corner within sight of the lawn or restaurant terrace, so parents can sit nearby, but away from wedding mandaps and pool decks. A pergola with seating gives shade in the dry heat. See also our Rajasthan page.

faq.q: Do you make wooden playground equipment for hotels?
faq.a: Yes. Our NexLev Woody range includes wooden play structures, and some other ranges use wooden and composite parts. These suit hotels and resorts that want a natural look.

faq.q: Where should a hotel place its play area?
faq.a: Within sight of a seating area so parents can watch, but away from pools, event lawns and driveways. Leave the full safe play area clear around each piece.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Udaipur?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from our factory in Vasai East, about 590 km away, and install through our own team or a dealer in western India.

intro: Udupi gets some of the heaviest monsoon rain on the west coast, and from June to September the steps, decks and paths around a playground rarely dry out fully. Slippery surfaces are the first thing to plan for. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colleges, temple trusts and housing projects in Udupi at our factory in Vasai East, about 700 km away.

The town is known for the Sri Krishna Matha, and nearby Manipal adds universities, hospitals and many staff families. The coast also brings humidity and salt air. Our trucks come down by road, and our own team or a dealer in south India handles the installation. Send us photos of the site in the rain if you have them, as they show where water collects better than any dry-season visit.

sections.h: Keeping play areas safe underfoot in heavy rain
sections.html:
Rubber flooring is the most useful surface for a wet coastal site, as it drains, dries quickly and grips better than tile or polished stone. Lay it across the full safe play area and on the path to the equipment. Avoid glazed tiles anywhere near the play area.

Sweep standing water and leaves off decks after a heavy shower, since a wet deck is where most slips start. Rope nets, such as the one on the Net Rock Climber, give children plenty of handholds. Galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts handle the rain and the sea air. See also our Mangalore page.

faq.q: What is the safest surface for a playground in heavy rain?
faq.a: Rubber flooring laid over a drained base. It dries faster than soil, does not turn to mud and gives better grip than tiles or polished stone.

faq.q: Do you supply Manipal as well as Udupi?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai East to both Udupi and Manipal and install through our own team or a dealer in south India.

faq.q: How often should a coastal playground be cleaned in the monsoon?
faq.a: Sweep standing water and leaves off decks after heavy rain, and scrub steps every few weeks. Rinse off salt with fresh water, especially on sites close to the sea.

intro: Ujjain receives visitors at the Mahakaleshwar temple all year, and during the Simhastha Kumbh the numbers rise many times over. Gardens, dharamshalas and public spaces here see children from all over the country, and the equipment has to take that use. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for parks, trusts, schools and colonies in Ujjain at our factory in Vasai East, about 520 km away.

The city is on the Malwa plateau in western Madhya Pradesh, close to Indore, with hot summers, a monsoon from June to September and cool winters. Delivery is by road, and a dealer in central India or our own installation team puts the equipment up. Share the size of the space, photos and an idea of how many children use it on a busy day. We will plan sturdy pieces and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Equipment for public spaces with heavy footfall
sections.html:
In a space used by many visiting families, choose fewer, stronger pieces over many small ones. Grout every post into concrete so nothing can be shifted, and avoid loose parts that can be carried away. A merry-go-round or a multi play station takes a group of children at once and keeps queues moving.

Fence the play area with one or two clear gates, so a caretaker can close it at night. Put up a sign with the age group for each piece. A trust or garden committee should name one person to check bolts, seats and chains every week in the busy season. See also our Indore page.

faq.q: What equipment holds up in a garden used by many visitors?
faq.a: Grouted, galvanised structures with roto-moulded parts and few loose fittings. Multi play stations and merry-go-rounds take groups at once, which keeps queues short on busy days.

faq.q: How often should a busy public playground be checked?
faq.a: Weekly during busy seasons. Check bolts, seats, chains and the surface under each piece, and call our after-sales team if anything is damaged.

faq.q: Do you install in Ujjain?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from our Vasai factory, about 520 km away, and install through our own team or a dealer in central India.

intro: Many housing societies in Ulhasnagar still have the playground they got when the building was new: a rusted slide, a swing with a cracked seat and bare ground underneath. FunPlay Systems replaces such play areas with new outdoor playground equipment, made at our factory in Vasai East, only about 30 km away. We also supply schools, gardens and new building projects in the town.

Ulhasnagar sits between Kalyan and Ambarnath in Thane district, a dense trading town where open space is precious. It shares the Mumbai region's heavy monsoon from June to September. With the factory this close, the equipment makes a short road trip, and our installation team or a local dealer fixes it on site. Send us photos of the old equipment and the space around it, and we will plan the new pieces on a layout drawing.

sections.html:
Before ordering, find out whether the old posts were set in concrete. Old footings often sit where the new layout needs open ground, and they may have to be broken out first, so tell us whether the society will arrange this. Ask members to clear the area and store anything worth keeping before installation day.

Use the change to fix the surface too. Bare ground or paver blocks under swings should give way to rubber flooring across the safe play area. Pick galvanised steel and roto-moulded parts, which last through Thane district's wet months far better than painted mild steel. For a project in the region, see our work for Raymond in Thane, or our Kalyan-Dombivli page.

faq.q: Can the old footings be reused for new equipment?
faq.a: Usually not, because new pieces have different post positions. Send us photos and a sketch of where the old footings are, and we will plan the new layout around them where possible.

faq.q: What should replace bare ground under old swings?
faq.a: Rubber flooring across the full safe play area. It cushions falls and does not turn to mud in the monsoon, unlike bare soil or a worn lawn.

faq.q: How close is your factory to Ulhasnagar?
faq.a: Our factory in Vasai East is about 30 km away. We deliver by road and install through our installation team or a local dealer.

intro: For a school or factory colony in Uluberia, the question that matters a year after installation is whom to call when a swing chain wears or a bolt works loose. FunPlay Systems has a separate after-sales team for this, and dealers in eastern India. We make outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,610 km away, and send it to Uluberia by road.

Uluberia is an industrial town on the west bank of the Hooghly in Howrah district, with jute mills, newer factories and growing residential areas. The climate is hot and humid, with a heavy monsoon from June to September. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer in the east. Tell us the size of your play area and the age group of the children. Before you place the order, we send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Service and spare parts after installation
sections.html:
Keep our after-sales number, +91 738 530 0921, and the email aftersales@funplaysystems.com with your warranty papers. When you report a problem, send a photo of the part, the name of the equipment and the date of installation. That lets us identify the part quickly.

Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year. Both apply when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions. In the humid months of the Hooghly belt, check bearings and chains more often. See also our Howrah page.

faq.q: Whom do we contact for repairs after installation?
faq.a: Our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com. Send a photo of the part, the equipment name and the installation date.

faq.q: What does the warranty cover?
faq.a: Manufacturing defects, for 3 years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and 1 year on springs, bearings and spare parts, when installed and maintained as instructed.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Uluberia?
faq.a: Yes. We send the equipment by road from Vasai East, about 1,610 km away, and install through our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

intro: On a small school ground in Unnao, the temptation is to fit in one more swing. The space around each piece matters as much as the piece itself, because a child who walks into the path of a moving swing can be badly hurt. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colonies and parks in Unnao at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,110 km away, and marks that space on every layout drawing.

Unnao lies between Kanpur and Lucknow in central Uttar Pradesh, with leather and industrial units along the highway and many schools in the town and district. Summers are very hot, winters are cold and foggy, and the monsoon runs from late June to September. The equipment travels by road and is installed by our team or a dealer in north India. Share the length and width of your ground, and we will show how many pieces fit safely.

sections.h: Planning safe zones around moving equipment
sections.html:
Every piece on our layout drawing has a safe play area around it, and these zones should not overlap with each other or with paths. Swings need the most room, in front and behind, because the seat travels well beyond the frame. A merry-go-round needs a clear ring all around it, and slides need space at the exit.

Put swings at a corner or edge of the ground, away from the main route children take. Keep benches, trees and water taps out of the safe zones. If the ground is too small for everything you want, drop a piece rather than squeeze the zones. A compact multi play station puts several activities inside one safe zone. See also our Kanpur page.

faq.q: What is a safe play area?
faq.a: It is the clear space around a piece of equipment that children may move or fall into. We mark it on the layout drawing, and nothing else, such as a bench or another piece, should sit inside it.

faq.q: How much space does a swing need?
faq.a: More than its frame, since the seats travel in front and behind. The exact safe play area depends on the model, and we mark it on the layout drawing.

faq.q: Do you install in Unnao?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver from Vasai by road, about 1,110 km, and install through our own team or a dealer in north India.

intro: A school in Varanasi's old city may sit at the end of a lane no truck can enter. Every part of a new playground then has to pass through the same gate the children use. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colleges, ashrams, hotels and colonies across Varanasi at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,230 km away. We plan the delivery as part of the layout.

Varanasi sits on the Ganga in eastern Uttar Pradesh, with very hot summers, a monsoon from late June to September and cold, foggy winters. Newer areas around Banaras Hindu University and on the edges of the city have more open ground. Our own team or a dealer in north India does the installation after the equipment arrives by road. Send us the size of your ground along with photos of the approach, and we will choose pieces that suit both.

sections.h: Getting equipment through narrow lanes and gates
sections.html:
Measure the narrowest point between the nearest truck stop and your ground, including gates, turns and any steps. Long items, such as a tall slide or a roof panel, need the most room, so share these measurements before you choose pieces. Where parts must be carried in, individual pieces such as spring riders and see-saws are simpler to move than one large structure.

Plan the delivery for early morning, before the lanes fill up, and keep space ready for unloading. A terrace or courtyard play area may need self-standing bases. See also our Delhi and UP page.

faq.q: Can you deliver to a school in a narrow lane?
faq.a: In most cases, yes. Send us the width of the lane and gate and the distance from where a truck can stop. We choose pieces that can be carried in and plan the delivery around them.

faq.q: Which equipment suits a small courtyard in the old city?
faq.a: Individual pieces such as spring riders, see-saws, a small slide or a compact play station. Self-standing bases suit courtyards with a finished floor.

faq.q: Do you supply Varanasi?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai East, about 1,230 km away, and install with our own team or a dealer in north India.

intro: Our factory is in Vasai East, so for buyers in Vasai, Virar and Nalasopara, FunPlay Systems is a local manufacturer in the plainest sense. We design, roto-mould and fabricate outdoor playground equipment a short drive from your site, for housing societies, schools, builders and parks across the Vasai-Virar municipal area.

We have made play equipment here since 2002, and the factory now covers 45,000 sq ft. The Konkan monsoon from June to September is heavy, and outdoor work on open ground slows down sharply in those months. Send us the size of your play area, photos and the age group of the children, and we will reply with a layout drawing and a quote. Our installation team or a local dealer then fixes the equipment on site.

sections.h: Timing your installation around the monsoon
sections.html:
Grouted posts set in concrete need dry days to cure, and rubber flooring needs a dry, level base. In Vasai and Virar, both are easiest between October and May. If you want the play area ready before the rains, approve the layout and quote early, so manufacturing and installation can finish before June.

If the monsoon has already arrived, self-standing equipment can go in on a firm base with less wet work. Builders planning a handover during the rains should keep this in mind. For an example of our work nearby, see the Raymond project in Thane. For adult fitness, see our Vasai-Virar outdoor gym page.

faq.q: Where exactly is your factory?
faq.a: In Vasai East, Palghar district, Maharashtra. We have manufactured playground equipment there since 2002, with in-house design, roto-moulding and fabrication.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be installed during the monsoon?
faq.a: Self-standing equipment on a firm base can go in during the rains. Grouted posts and rubber flooring need dry weather, so plan these for October to May where possible.

faq.q: Do you supply Nalasopara and Virar too?
faq.a: Yes. We supply housing societies, schools and builders across Vasai, Virar and Nalasopara, and install through our installation team or a local dealer.

intro: Vellore draws patients and their families from across India to its large hospitals, and many stay in the city for weeks. Children who come along need somewhere to play, and hospital campuses, guest houses and staff quarters can plan a small play corner for them. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for such campuses, and for schools, colleges and colonies in Vellore, at our factory in Vasai East, about 980 km away.

Vellore is known for its fort as well as its university and medical colleges. It has some of the hottest summers in Tamil Nadu, from March to June, and gets its rain mainly from October to December. After the equipment reaches Vellore by road, our team or a dealer in south India installs it. Send us the size of the space and photos, and we will suggest a compact set with a layout drawing marking the safe play area.

sections.h: A play corner on a hospital or residential campus
sections.html:
On a campus where families wait, the play corner should be small, quiet and easy to supervise. Pick low, slow pieces such as a small play station, spring riders and a see-saw. Skip fast spinning equipment. Place the corner in shade near seating, away from ambulance routes and parking.

Hospital staff will want surfaces they can clean easily, and roto-moulded plastic and rubber flooring can both be washed down with water. In Vellore's heat, a pergola or the shade of a building keeps slides cool. Our garden decor range includes benches and pergolas. Elsewhere in Tamil Nadu, see our resort playground in Dindigul.

faq.q: What equipment suits a play corner at a hospital?
faq.a: Low, slow pieces such as spring riders, a see-saw and a small play station. They suit children of different ages and are easy for staff to clean and watch.

faq.q: How do we keep equipment cool in Vellore's summer?
faq.a: Place it in the shade of a building or under a pergola, and choose lighter colours for slides and seats. Morning and evening play avoids the hottest hours.

faq.q: Do you supply Vellore?
faq.a: Yes. Equipment is made at our Vasai East factory, delivered by road and installed by our team or a dealer in south India.

intro: Once children reach nine or ten, a slide and a swing rarely hold their interest for long, and schools in Vijayanagaram often ask what to add for older pupils. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for all ages, including climbing and balancing pieces for older children, at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,120 km away.

Vijayanagaram, also spelt Vizianagaram, is a district headquarters on the north Andhra coast, close to Visakhapatnam, with a historic fort and many schools and colleges. It is hot and humid, with heavy monsoon rain and, in some years, cyclones from the Bay of Bengal. The equipment comes by road, and our team or a dealer in south India installs it. Tell us the age range of the pupils, and we will plan the mix on a layout drawing.

sections.h: Equipment that holds older children's interest
sections.html:
Older children want a challenge: climbing higher, balancing and testing their strength. Overhead ladders such as the S Bridge Climber and low balancing beams give them that at heights suited to their age. A larger tower from the NexLev Pinnacle range gives them more to climb.

Place these pieces apart from the younger children's area, so a fast-moving group of older pupils does not crowd the small ones. Lay rubber flooring suited to the height of each climber. Check the age group listed for each piece before you finalise. See also our Visakhapatnam page.

faq.q: What playground equipment suits children aged 8 to 12?
faq.a: Climbers, overhead ladders, balancing beams and taller play towers. They test strength and balance, and should be placed apart from equipment for younger children.

faq.q: Can one playground serve both younger and older pupils?
faq.a: Yes, with separate zones. We plan low pieces for younger children and climbing equipment for older ones on one layout drawing, each with its safe play area.

faq.q: Do you install in Vijayanagaram?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from our Vasai factory, about 1,120 km away, and install with our own team or a dealer in south India.

intro: Visakhapatnam's beach road parks and hillside viewpoints draw large crowds of families every evening, and a single small slide gets lost in spaces that size. Larger parks here need a feature structure that children can spot from across the lawn. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for such parks, and for schools, townships and housing projects in Vizag, at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,110 km away.

Vizag is a port and naval city with a steel plant and a growing residential belt, set between the Eastern Ghats and the Bay of Bengal. It is warm and humid all year, with salt air along the coast and cyclones in some years. We ship by road from Vasai, and installation is by our own team or a south Indian dealer. Send the size of the park and photos, and we will propose a layout with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Feature play towers for large public parks
sections.html:
For a big park, one large structure from our NexLev Series, such as an Escapade adventure structure, can serve as the centrepiece, with smaller stations around it for younger children. A large structure gives many children something to do at once and is easy for parents to keep in view.

On a site exposed to sea winds, grout the posts and choose galvanised steel and roto-moulded parts, which do not rust in salt air. Rinse the equipment with fresh water after windy spells. Keep beach sand out of the play zone where you can, since sand wears moving parts. For park walkers, see our Visakhapatnam outdoor gym page.

faq.q: What equipment works for a large public park?
faq.a: A large feature structure, such as one from our NexLev Series, with smaller play stations, swings and spring riders around it. This spreads the crowd and gives each age group its own space.

faq.q: How do we protect equipment near the beach?
faq.a: Choose galvanised steel and roto-moulded parts, grout the posts and rinse with fresh water from time to time. Keep loose beach sand out of the play zone where possible.

faq.q: Do you install in Visakhapatnam?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai East and install with our own team or a dealer in south India.

intro: When a Warangal school or colony committee collects three or four quotes for a playground, the totals rarely compare like for like. One quote may include installation and flooring while another leaves them out. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colleges, colonies and parks in Warangal at our factory in Vasai East, about 720 km away. We will explain line by line what our quote covers.

Warangal, the old Kakatiya capital known for its fort and the Thousand Pillar Temple, is also an education centre with a National Institute of Technology. Summers are hot and dry, and the monsoon runs from June to September. A dealer in south India or our own installation team sets up the equipment once it arrives by road. Send the site size, photos and the age group, and our layout drawing will show exactly which pieces the quote covers.

sections.html:
• Check what is included: equipment, delivery, installation and any rubber flooring.
  • Ask for a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, so you know the pieces actually fit.
  • Compare warranty terms part by part. Ours gives 3 years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and 1 year on springs, bearings and spare parts.
  • Ask who installs the equipment and whom to call afterwards.

Check the material of each part too. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic hold up better in Warangal's summer heat than painted mild steel. See our Telangana page and our individual equipment.

faq.q: What should a playground quote include?
faq.a: The list of equipment, delivery, the installation method, any flooring and the warranty terms. Ask for a layout drawing with the safe play area so you can check that everything fits.

faq.q: Why do playground quotes differ so much?
faq.a: Quotes can differ in materials, the size of each piece and whether delivery, installation and flooring are included. Compare these line by line before you look at the final total.

faq.q: Do you supply Warangal?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from our Vasai factory, about 720 km away, and install with our own team or a dealer in south India.

intro: Yamunanagar is one of India's main plywood and timber centres, so buyers here know wood well and often ask whether a playground can be made of it. Some of ours are. FunPlay Systems makes wooden play structures in our NexLev range, along with galvanised steel and roto-moulded equipment, at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,280 km away.

The city lies in northern Haryana near the Shivalik foothills, beside the Yamuna, with hot summers, a monsoon from July to September and cold, foggy winters. We supply schools, colonies, factory campuses and parks here, with equipment sent by road and installed by our team or a dealer in north India. Tell us whether you prefer wood, plastic or a mix, and we will suggest pieces on a layout drawing.

sections.h: Wooden or steel and plastic play equipment
sections.html:
Wooden structures from our NexLev Woody range look natural beside lawns and trees, and suit farmhouses, resorts and schools that want a softer look. Galvanised steel with roto-moulded plastic needs less routine care and comes in more than 15 colours.

Wood outdoors needs attention. Check it each year for cracks and splinters, and keep the base dry so the foot of each post does not stay wet. Yamunanagar's mix of summer heat, monsoon rain and winter damp is hard on any timber, so follow the maintenance steps we share at handover. We also offer composite products in some ranges. See also our Saharanpur page.

faq.q: Is wooden playground equipment suitable for north India's weather?
faq.a: Yes, with regular care. Check wooden parts every year for cracks and splinters, keep post bases dry and follow our maintenance instructions, since heat, rain and winter damp all affect timber.

faq.q: Which needs less maintenance, wood or plastic?
faq.a: Galvanised steel with roto-moulded plastic parts needs less routine care than wood. Wood gives a natural look that many resorts and farmhouses prefer.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Yamunanagar?
faq.a: Yes. We send the equipment by road from Vasai East, about 1,280 km away, and install through our own team or a dealer in north India.
